name: Copper articles subject to 50% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 10962 as amended by Proclamation 11021)
notes: Proclamation 10962 (July 30, 2025, effective August 1, 2025): 50% ad valorem duty on semi-finished copper products and intensive copper derivative products from all countries.
Original valuation methodology (Aug 2025 – Apr 2026): 50% assessed on copper CONTENT value only, not total entered value. Non-copper content faced no S232 duty (HTSUS 9903.78.01/9903.78.02).

Proclamation 11021 (April 2, 2026, effective April 6, 2026): changed valuation to 50% on FULL CUSTOMS VALUE for articles entirely/almost entirely made of copper. Derivative copper articles substantially made of copper: 25% on full value (see steel_aluminum_copper_derivatives_04_02_2026.json).
CBP CSMS #65794272 identifies the Chapter 99 reporting headings: 9903.78.01 (copper content, 50%) and 9903.78.02 (non-copper content, 0%).

The official HTS code annex (Annex to Proclamation 10962) covers 76 subheadings in Chapter 74 and 4 subheadings in Chapter 85 (8544.42.10, 8544.42.20, 8544.42.90, 8544.49.10). All 80 codes verified from the FR 2025-14893 PDF annex.
Codes in this file are the full 10-digit HTSUS subheadings from the proclamation annex (subdivision (b) of U.S. note 36 to subchapter III of chapter 99).
Section 232 copper tariffs exempt goods already subject to Section 232 auto/parts tariffs (no stacking). S232 goods are also exempt from the Section 122 temporary surcharge.

Proclamation 11021 Annex I-A includes only Chapter 74 (primary copper articles). The four Chapter 85 insulated-wire codes (8544.42.10, 8544.42.20, 8544.42.90, 8544.49.10) originally added by Proclamation 10962 as 'intensive copper derivative products' are derivative articles under Proclamation 11021 and belong in Annex I-B (25%). They have been moved to steel_aluminum_copper_derivatives_04_02_2026.json.
